title: Methodology & ethics
subtitle: How scores are built, where data comes from, and the rules we never break.

scoring.title: How scoring works
scoring.p1: Each location receives ten category scores (0–100): public safety, healthcare access, weather & climate, business potential, infrastructure, environment, transportation, education, economic activity and tourism.
scoring.p2: The Personal Decision Assistant re-weights those same category scores for your goal. A business query leans on economic activity, infrastructure and transport; a health query leans on healthcare access, environment and climate. The underlying data never changes — only the weights do.

bands.strongDesc: Conditions are favourable. Advantages outweigh challenges for most goals.
bands.workableDesc: Usable with caveats. Specific challenges should be planned around.
bands.atRiskDesc: Significant gaps or hazards. Decisions here need careful justification.

placesNeverPeople.title: Places, never people
placesNeverPeople.text: TerraLens analyses environmental patterns in locations. It does not identify, profile, score or label individuals.

noPrediction.title: No criminal prediction
noPrediction.text: Public safety scores are built only from aggregated, verified incident counts.

noDiscrimination.title: No proxy discrimination
noDiscrimination.text: Appearance, ethnicity, neighbourhood demographics are never inputs.

transparent.title: Transparent sourcing
transparent.text: Every data point carries a source and a date. Where data is unreliable, the interface says so.

aiExplains.title: AI explains itself
aiExplains.text: Every score ships with a plain-language explanation citing the underlying data.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.p: In production, TerraLens aggregates publicly available and authorised data from source families like these. Every data point carries its source and date.
list: National statistics (population, economic activity, cost of living)
State emergency management (flooding, fire, response coverage)
Open geographic data (hospitals, schools, businesses, roads)
sources.disclaimer: Demo disclaimer: All figures are simulated sample data. Scores illustrate methodology and must not be used for real decisions.
